records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Our asset-based segments, Expedited and Dedicated, contributed approximately 68% of total revenue, 85% of operating income, 62% of total freight revenue, and 59% of adjusted operating income in the quarter.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Our asset-light segments, Managed Freight and Warehousing, contributed approximately 32% of total revenue, 15% of operating income, 38% of total freight revenue, and 41% of adjusted operating income in the quarter and combined to generate favorable margins and returns.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Our Expedited segment grew revenue and operating ratio but adjusted operating ratio deteriorated compared to the third quarter last year.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Our Dedicated segment produced higher revenue and better margins year over year but fell short of improving margins sequentially due to similar cost headwinds experienced by Expedited.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: ● Operating income of $59.1 million, compared with $20.1 million in the third quarter of 2021;
